name: Breakwater
weather: driving monsoon rain, gale gusts, heavy swell
designIntent: Defend the civilian ferry evacuation of Marrow Bay against a naval gun monitor, hover skiff packs, and shore mechs in driving rain — the war's cost made visible.
teaches: storm-rain heat dissipation bonus (x1.15) and flooded-ground footing

briefing.speaker: Relay
briefing.text: Marrow Bay is drowning twice tonight. The Directorate is pulling out of the coast, and they've decided the town doesn't get to stay behind them — Kryce calls it 'decommissioning non-viable settlements.' Four thousand people, Lodestar. The Compact has three ferries running them across the bay to the karst caves, and the Directorate means to sink every one. Threat board: a naval gun monitor is holding station past the breakwater — single turret, but it throws a shell the size of a Ferric. Hover skiffs will run the shallows in packs, and shore mechs are pushing up the coast road. You hold the waterline. Sable takes the lighthouse rock for overwatch, Tremor anchors the quay, Vireo screens the loading queues. Priority is always the ferries — let one wave of skiffs through and people die by the hundred. The rain will keep you cool. Use that. Fire until the barrels glow, and keep that monitor's gun off my boats.

objectives.title: Hold the Waterline
objectives.description: Defend the ferry loading quays through three full evacuation cycles.

objectives.title: Sink the Monitor
objectives.description: Destroy the naval gun monitor holding station beyond the breakwater.

objectives.title: Break the Skiff Packs
objectives.description: Intercept the hover skiff waves running the shallows toward the quays.

objectives.title: Last Boat Out
objectives.description: Escort the final ferry through the breakwater gap and out of gun range.

objectives.title: Coast Road
objectives.description: Collapse the coast road bridge to cut the shore mech advance off from the town.

enemyForces: Naval gun monitor 'Ledger' beyond the breakwater, firing heavy shells and illumination rounds
Hover skiff packs running the shallows in waves
Shore mech column on the coast road: Halite pairs led by a Basalt
Ferric APCs landing infantry at the fish quays
Strafing aircraft slipping in between squalls
setPieces: Monitor shells walk across the harbor, hurling water columns higher than the mechs
An illumination shell freezes the whole bay in white light mid-firefight
A near-miss lifts the second ferry's bow out of the water; it rights itself to ragged cheering on comms
The final ferry runs the breakwater gap under a full barrage as the monitor burns
Kryce's evacuation-denial broadcast plays over the town's public address towers during the fighting
failConditions: The ferry loading quay is destroyed
salvageNotes: Skiff wrecks wash ashore all mission — light pickings but plentiful. The shore Basalt is the prize: leg it on the coast road and the Compact drags it into town after the storm. The monitor goes down in deep water; nothing comes back from that.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: First ferry's loading now. Thirteen hundred souls to a hull. No pressure, right?

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Heavy-caliber naval fire detected. Shell time-of-flight: eleven seconds.

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: Skiffs in the shallows — four, no, six! They're pushing for the quays!

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: That's the quay held! You want the town, you go through me and forty-five tons of bad news!

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Monitor's turret tracks slow between squalls. Wait for the rain to thicken. Then close.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Ferry two took spray, not steel — she's upright, she's moving. Thank every saint of this coast.

voTriggers.speaker: Kryce
voTriggers.line: Residents of the coastal exclusion zone: your relocation is proceeding ahead of schedule. The Directorate thanks you for your cooperation.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Hull integrity critical. The rain is aiding coolant recovery. Your armor is another matter.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Heat elevated. Storm precipitation is accelerating dissipation. You may sustain fire longer than they expect.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: SHE'S GONE UNDER! HA! The bay just got a new reef!

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Last boat's away — keep the gap clear, Lodestar, and Marrow Bay lives to hate the rain another day.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: All ferries across. Four thousand and eleven. I counted. Somebody had to. Good work, everyone.
